subject.title: fix(plugins): terminate git clone args so git: specs cannot inject options

question: Should maintainers accept this plugin/skill install security hardening, including rejecting dash-leading `git:` specs and adding `--` at both clone call sites?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well supported, but it deliberately changes security-boundary behavior for untrusted install specs and rejects an edge-case input shape that current code accepted.

options.title: Land after current-merge validation
options.body: Accept the narrow compatibility break and merge once maintainer/security review and exact merge-head checks are satisfied.

options.title: Preserve dash-leading compatibility
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps parser acceptance and relies only on argv termination if maintainers need to support bare dash-leading repository names.

options.title: Pause for broader install hardening
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want this mitigation folded into a larger plugin and skill install security review.

recommendation.title: Land after current-merge validation
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow compatibility break and merge once maintainer/security review and exact merge-head checks are satisfied.
